Maya Lopez: Quick thread for Meridian QBR prep. Need final deck, risk grade, and exec asks locked by EOD Tue.

Diego Alvarez: I'm finishing the usage + SLA slide. Will drop v1 to drive by tomorrow AM. Need someone to validate churn overlay.

Priya Shah: I'll take the churn overlay and onboarding KPIs. Pulling latest Gainsight numbers now. ETA Tue 10am.

Liam O'Connor: Enablement wants a 10-min demo of the self-serve runbook. Suggest Ops appendix rather than exec readout.

Maya Lopez: Agreed. Liam please prepare 1-slide summary + 1 screenshot. Keep it concise.

Diego Alvarez: Uploaded draft here: https://drive.redwood/meridian/qbr/v3 - comments welcome.

Priya Shah: Onboarding snapshot for copy: - Seats: 1,275; Active MAUs 905; Completion 74%; Time-to-success 6.5 days.

Maya Lopez: Renewal posture: CSAT flat, usage dip in two power-user cohorts. Setting Amber risk. Mitigations: targeted enablement, exec sync, short credits incentive.

Diego Alvarez: Draft exec ask: 30-min sync to review trends + approve 6-week usage credits pilot. Keep it 3 bullets.

Maya Lopez: Drafting now, will post for edits.

OpsBot: Reminder: QBR template check in 48 hrs. Missing exec ask or >12 slides will fail auto-validate.

Maya Lopez: Final exec ask pasted: 30-min strategic sync to 1) review usage and roadmap alignment, 2) approve 6-week usage credits pilot (target +10% active users), 3) endorse quarterly enablement cadence and technical deep-dive. Please sign off.

Priya Shah: Edit: explicitly state "6-week usage credits pilot" and success metric yes. Signed.

Liam O'Connor: Enablement slide done; attaching GIF. Signed.

Diego Alvarez: I'll trim deck to 11 slides and upload final Mon 9am. Signed.

Maya Lopez: Action items: Diego upload final deck (Mon 9am); Priya final metrics + churn graph (Tue 10am); Liam enablement slide + GIF (Tue 4pm); Samira (CSM) confirm exec avail & send invite (Mon EOD); Maya finalize exec ask & coordinate demo (Mon 3pm).

OpsBot: Task created: #QBR-Meridian-Prep assigned to Maya/Diego/Priya/Liam/Samira, due Mon.
